# Proposing a Question for Our Survey
# DUE MONDAY, NOVEMBER 30 (BEFORE CLASS)

We are going to write our own questions for a national survey of about 2,000 American adults that Morning Consult will field over Thanksgiving. Before you start, read the [class survey page](https://clintojd.github.io/psci2300-fall2026/survey/) and spend some time on the Morning Consult links there.

In this problem set **you** propose a question for the survey and a plan for how you will analyze it.

We are writing the plan *before* we see any data. This is called a **pre-analysis plan**. Writing it first keeps us honest: we cannot change our hypothesis or go looking for a result that we like after the data come in.

Recall that problem sets are graded by completion. I want you to try to figure things out on your own, with friends, or with help from me or Alex. The point is to understand what the code is doing and what the results mean.

You can also use AI to help you. But use it to help, don't outsource your thinking and agency to a machine. If you want to be capable you need to be able to work _with_ AI.

Fill in the answers in the spots below. Test things out using `Run Current Chunk` and then, when everything works, `Knit` from above - `Knit to PDF` is best. Make sure you save the name of this file to contain your VUNET ID!

The questions are in *italics*. Put your written answers after each question and your code in the answer chunk.
